approval.intro: Items for the owner to confirm at 1440 and 390. Each one is a value chosen without a Figma design.
approval.fontsHint: Check that the Cyrillic line is PT Serif (not a system serif) and sits well beside the Latin one.
approval.fontCyrillic: PT Serif, Cyrillic (Lusitana has no Cyrillic)
approval.languageSwitchHint: Built from the Nav pill look; confirm the RU / EN label and where it sits in the header and the menu.
approval.loadingHint: A spinner follows the label; the button stays focusable and ignores clicks while loading.
approval.glass: Glass approximation over a Figma texture
approval.glassHint: Compare with the Figma glass: blur 24 and a light top edge stand in for the refraction.
approval.glassBody: Backdrop blur and a light top edge stand in for the Figma refraction.
approval.checklistHint: Confirm each one, or say what to change.

items.motion: Motion timings: hover 180 ms, press ripple 600 ms, easing cubic-bezier(0.2, 0, 0, 1). Figma records none.
items.states: Hover, pressed and disabled looks that Figma does not draw (Outline, Graphite, Save, fields, cards, heart, carousel arrows).
items.primaryFocus: Primary button focus: white 2 px border, also on the light catalog surfaces.
items.focusRings: Focus ring colour per tone: accent-focus on dark surfaces, ink-primary on light ones.
items.mobileMenu: Mobile menu panel: Figma draws only the Menu and Close buttons, the panel is built from existing tokens.
items.headerBreakpoint: Header switches at 1280 px: Full above, Compact (logo, Cart, Menu) below.
items.tabBar: Tab bar: the active tab differs by colour only, no indicator; hidden from 768 px.
items.footer: Footer links and social buttons without a known destination render as disabled, not as dead links.
items.ruDraft: Russian copy and the language switch are drafts for owner review.
